method: Primary publisher, standards-owner or software-maintainer sources checked using web search and page opening; access limits recorded per item. No equipment accessed.

sources.title: NumPy 2.4.0 Release Notes
sources.verification: Official HTML opened; Expired deprecations, Removal of deprecated functions and arguments, lists removal of numpy.trapz and recommends numpy.trapezoid or SciPy integration.
sources.supports: The observed AttributeError and the explicit one-call API repair.
sources.does_not_support: Numerical correctness or scientific validity of ElectraTwin.

sources.title: FiPy 3.4.4: Finite Volume Method and Discretization
sources.verification: Official HTML opened and read: integration over control volumes, divergence theorem and sums of convective/diffusive face fluxes; local algebraic equations.
sources.supports: The rationale for balancing cell-face transport and boundary reaction fluxes and auditing conservation separately from iteration change.
sources.does_not_support: Validation of this repository solver against a real microreactor.

sources.title: FiPy 3.4.4: Numerical Schemes
sources.verification: Official HTML opened and read: face Peclet number is convective strength divided by diffusive conductance; central differencing positivity restriction and numerical diffusion of first-order upwind are discussed.
sources.supports: Using Peclet diagnostics and grid refinement when interpreting upwind concentration fields.
sources.does_not_support: Treating a large mean axial Peclet number as proof that diffusion is negligible near every wall or inlet corner.

sources.title: ACS Green Chemistry Institute: Process Mass Intensity Calculation Tool
sources.verification: Official HTML opened and read; dated 2014-10-16. PMI is total raw material input including water divided by product/API output.
sources.supports: Full-process PMI requires an explicitly stated material boundary including water; the source's feed-only numerator is a partial-boundary proxy.
sources.does_not_support: Calling the source calculation full-process ACS-compliant PMI, or inferring life-cycle greenness from one mass metric.

sources.title: ACS: Green Chemistry and Engineering: Towards a Sustainable Future
sources.verification: Official PDF opened, 30 pages; text on page 4 defines E-factor as waste mass per product mass and PMI as material input per product mass; discusses limits of a single metric.
sources.supports: E-factor = waste/product; PMI = input/product. E = PMI - 1 follows only with a common boundary, mass closure and all non-product output counted as waste.
sources.does_not_support: Assuming omitted workup or recycled streams are zero, or interpreting E-factor alone as an environmental impact assessment.

sources.title: Scaling-up Electroorganic Synthesis Using a Spinning Electrode Electrochemical Reactor in Batch and Flow Mode
sources.verification: Publisher-indexed abstract and article excerpts read through search. They describe a rotating cylinder electrode with a 5 mm gap, multi-100 g batch demonstrations, and kilogram-per-day flow operation. Direct publisher opening and ChemRxiv PDF opening returned 403; no full SI review claimed.
sources.supports: A documented reactor architecture beyond continuous-flow microchannels exists; the source's claim that microchannels are the only industrial pathway is unsupported.
sources.does_not_support: General commercial qualification of every batch design, or scale-up readiness of this project.

sources.title: Tektronix: Model 2450 Interactive SourceMeter Instrument Reference Manual
sources.verification: Official landing page opened and read; states that the reference manual covers SCPI and TSP commands over a remote interface and warns to match manual revision to the instrument. Official 2450-901-01E PDF indexed contents were read; direct PDF open failed.
sources.supports: SCPI is a real remote-programming interface supported by the named instrument family, whose model and revision documentation must govern actual integration.
sources.does_not_support: Ownership, availability, connection, instrument identity, command-level compatibility, calibrated voltage or hardware validation of the source emulator.

sources.title: BoTorch acquisition documentation: ExpectedHypervolumeImprovement
sources.verification: Official indexed API excerpts read through search: ExpectedHypervolumeImprovement takes a model, reference point and partitioning. Tutorial indexed text discusses fitted surrogate models and posterior-based acquisition functions. Direct tutorial open failed; no full tutorial execution claimed.
sources.supports: A deterministic hypervolume evaluation is not itself EHVI; a posterior predictive model and acquisition-based selection are required.
sources.does_not_support: Bayesian or constrained optimization in the submitted fixed-grid loop.
